title: Creating Authentic Power – Introduction
fullTitle: Soul Feast #4: Creating Authentic Power – Introduction
description: In today’s Soul Feast, Gary Zukav dives into the transformative power of the New Consciousness and how it shifts our understanding of Authentic Power.

He explains how the New Consciousness redefines power, moving away from the old model of manipulation and control (external power) to the alignment of your personality with your soul, which creates Authentic Power.
This shift, Gary emphasizes, brings with it a deeper focus on the heart and how it becomes the central force in our spiritual evolution.
Gary also highlights the importance of emotional awareness and how recognizing the energy of emotions—whether rooted in love or fear—is essential for creating authentic power.
He explains that our emotions provide valuable information from our soul , guiding us to make responsible choices that lead to growth, healing, and deeper connection with the universe.
